title: Administrative hearings: Principles and conduct
subject: This guide sets out the principles and procedures adopted by ASIC in conducting administrative hearings. It is intended for persons who are the subject of such hearings.
background: ASIC has obligations under the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) and other legislation to hold administrative hearings in certain circumstances. The guide explains ASIC's powers when conducting hearings and the legislative framework governing these processes.
ruling: ASIC outlines guiding principles for administrative hearings including fairness, transparency, and efficiency. The guide details procedures for notice of hearing, service requirements, time to prepare, and who may attend. It addresses joint and concurrent hearings, stop order hearings, public versus private hearings, and the role of an assistant to the delegate. ASIC also provides guidance on witnesses, summoning persons to attend, and taking oaths or affirmations.
